<div class="trb-caption">

<div class="item" style='background-image: url("/Uploads/Public/Images/Centennial/TRB_100years.jpg"); height: 250px;'>

<div class="row">
<div class="col-xs-12">
<section aria-label="Resources" class="trb-tabbed-content">
<ul class="nav nav-tabs">
<li class="active"><a data-toggle="tab" href="#connect"><span aria-hidden="true" class="hidden-xs hidden-sm hidden-md ico-user-add"></span>Connect</a></li>
<li><a data-toggle="tab" href="#convene"><span aria-hidden="true" class="hidden-xs hidden-sm hidden-md ico-users"></span>Convene</a></li>
<li><a data-toggle="tab" href="#research"><span aria-hidden="true" class="hidden-xs hidden-sm hidden-md ico-box"></span>Research</a></li>
<li class="last"><a data-toggle="tab" href="#advise"><span aria-hidden="true" class="hidden-xs hidden-sm hidden-md ico-talk-chat"></span>Advise</a></li>
</ul>
<div class="tab-content">
<div class="tab-pane fade in active" id="connect">
<p>TRB's work relies on volunteers and seeks to involve transportation professionals at every stage of their career. Get involved by receiving updates, volunteering, or responding to proposals:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/Contact/Contact.aspx">Contact staff</a></li>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/Publications/PubsTRBENewsletter.aspx">Subscribe to the E-Newsletter</a></li>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/ElectronicSessions/Twitter.aspx">Follow us on Social Media</a></li>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/GetInvolvedwithTRB/volunteer.aspx">Volunteer</a></li>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/publications/pubstrnewsmagazine.aspx">Read the TR News</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.mytrb.org/Committees/SelfNominationAsFriend">Become a Friend of a Technical Committee</a></li>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/GetInvolvedwithTRB/propose.aspx">Respond to Requests for Proposals</a></li>
<li class="last"><a href="https://careers.mytrb.org/">Visit the Job Center</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="tab-pane fade" id="convene">
<p>TRB’s community links thousands of passionate transportation professionals from around the world, which strengthens personal and professional connections, supports dialogue and establishes information-exchange. Learn about TRB’s:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/AboutTRB/StandingCommitteesMT.aspx">Standing Committees</a></li>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/AnnualMeeting/AnnualMeeting.aspx">Annual Meeting</a></li>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/Calendar/Calendar.aspx">Conferences and Webinars</a></li>
<li class="last"><a href="http://www.trb.org/AboutTRB/MinorityStudent.aspx">Minority Student Fellows Program</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="tab-pane fade" id="research">
<p>Through an objective and interdisciplinary approach, TRB stimulates research on topics that will have the greatest impact on transportation. TRB’s research includes practical and ready-to-implement products, a bibliographic database, and a peer-reviewed journal. Learn more about:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://trid.trb.org/">TRID</a></li>
<li><a href="http://trrjournalonline.trb.org/">Transportation Research Record: Journal of the Transportation Research Board</a></li>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/NCHRP/NCHRP.aspx">National Cooperative Highway Research Program (NCHRP)</a></li>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/TCRP/TCRP.aspx">Transit Cooperative Research Program (TCRP)</a></li>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/ACRP/ACRP.aspx">Airport Cooperative Research Program (ACRP)</a></li>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/NCFRP/NCFRP.aspx">National Cooperative Freight Research Program (NCFRP)</a></li>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/HMCRP/HMCRP.aspx">Hazardous Materials Cooperative Research Program (HMCRP)</a></li>
<li class="last"><a href="http://www.trb.org/NCRRP/NCRRP.aspx">National Cooperative Rail Research Program (NCRRP)</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="tab-pane fade" id="advise">
<p>Since 1982, TRB has conducted more than 100 studies at the request of Congress, executive-branch federal agencies, the states, and other organizations, providing objective and interdisciplinary advice on complex and controversial transportation topics. Learn about TRB’s:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="http://www.trb.org/PolicyStudies/PolicyStudies.aspx">Studies and Special Programs</a></li>
<li class="last"><a href="http://www.trb.org/MarineBoard/Public/MarineBoard.aspx">Marine Board</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>

					if ($('input[name="HtmlSearchCriteria"]').length > 0) {

								if (value.indexOf('&') >= 0)
								    value = value.replace(/&/g, '%26');
								$('input[name="HtmlSearchCriteria"]').val(value);
								$('input[name="HtmlSearchCriteria"]').siblings('input[type="button"], input[type="submit"]').click();
							},
							autoFocus: true,
							delay: 10,
							minLength: 2
						});
					}
